title: 第003章 卖符的骗子第004章 大师
lines: 第003章卖符的骗子
陈默离开学校，忽然间想起来他现在是借宿在安可悦家中，不由的一阵头大。
陈默老家在凤山县，父亲陈兢业在凤山县下属一个镇当副禛长，母亲李素芬在省会汉阳市打拼。
为了让陈默将来能够考上好点的大学，特地把陈默送来整个汉阳省最好的高中，武州第一高中。
正好是武州本地人的安可悦一家得到消息，在安可悦母亲梅婷的大力邀请下，李素芳便把陈默寄宿在安家，也好有个照应。
如果是前世的陈默，能够和暗恋的女神同住一个屋檐下，自然是求之不得。
可这一世，已经知道安家人嘴脸的陈默，实在无法继续住在安家。
更何况就在刚才，陈默还冷落了安大小姐。如果现在回去安家，不是自讨苦吃吗？
“安家是回不去了，而且住在安家也不方便以后修炼，最好在外面租个房子。”
陈默打定主意，准备去学校附近转转，看看有没有合适的房子。
可摸了摸口袋里为数不多的生活费，陈默不由的一阵苦笑。
李素芳知道陈默纨绔的性格，所以对陈默的经济约束非常严格，为了不让陈默在外面胡混，每个月只给陈默一千块的零花钱。
如果对于普通学生来说，吃住都在安家，一千块足够多了，可对于前世陈默，却还不够他去一趟KTV。
有生以来第一次，化神境大修士陈默，居然为了钱而发愁。
不过，这点小事还难不倒陈默。
他立刻去商店买了一些朱砂毛笔和白纸，准备画几道简易版的符箓，虽说这些符箓的功效不及原版的万分之一，可对于地球上的普通人来说，远胜过那些人参首乌。
在僻静之地制作好几道符箓，夜幕已经降临。陈默找了一个人流量较多的公园，在路边摆起了地摊。
华灯初上，一个穿校服的少年，静静盘坐在路边，身前的破纸皮上摆了几道稀奇古怪的鬼画符。
路过的大爷大妈，青年男女，看着陈默纷纷露出讥笑，这年头，真是世风日下，连学生都出来招摇撞骗了吗？
陈默对这些人的态度却是不闻不问，六百年的修炼，早已让他道心坚如磐石。这些嘲讽对他来说无异于清风拂面，一笑而过。
陈默相信，茫茫人海，总有那么一两个识货之人。
“你这些符都能干什么呢？”一个穿着白色羽绒服的长发女孩，半蹲在陈默身前，葱白般的玉手，轻轻翻动那几张符纸。
陈默看了眼，女孩大约二十来岁，身材高挑，眉清目秀，肤白貌美，气质淡雅中却透着一股高贵，比安可悦还要美上三分！
不过陈默只是淡淡看了一眼，便收回目光，指着那些符纸，平淡说道：“宁神醒脑，驱邪除晦，安宅定风，强身健体！”
“宁神醒脑？”女孩一愣，美目闪过一丝期盼，紧盯着陈默问：“如果有人神志错乱，经常胡言乱语，甚至连自己最亲近之人都不认得，你这符，能治好吗？”
陈默一指最左边的那道符，说道：“你说的那个情况，在我看来便是阴阳失衡，地魂不归，现代医学解释为神经衰弱，那道宁神符最适合。”
女孩拿起那道宁神符，仔细查看，实在看不出有何特别之处，反而就像是小孩子随便拿笔画了几道。
陈默不想让这位好不容易对他这些符箓感兴趣的客人跑了，继续解释：“人生具三魂七魄，三魂者，一为天魂，二为地魂，三为命魂。七魄者，一魄天冲，二魄灵慧，三魄为气，四魄为力，五破中枢，六魄为精，七魄为英。”
“三魂当中，天地二魂常在外，唯有命魂住其身，天魂为阳，地魂为阴。阳气盛则天魂强，阴气盛则地魂凶，唯有阴阳调和，人才能精力旺盛，百病不生。”
女孩听得云里雾里，似懂非懂，但，她觉得陈默所言，似乎很有道理。

Chapter 003 The liar who sells charms
Chen Mo left school and suddenly remembered that he was staying at An Keyue's house, and couldn't help but feel a headache.
Chen Mo's hometown is in Fengshan County. His father, Chen Jingye, is the deputy chief of a town under Fengshan County, and his mother, Li Sufen, works hard in Hanyang City, the provincial capital.
In order for Chen Mo to be admitted to a better university in the future, Chen Mo was specially sent to the best high school in Hanyang Province, Wuzhou No. 1 High School.
An Keyue's family, who happened to be locals in Wuzhou, got the news. At the strong invitation of An Keyue's mother Mei Ting, Li Sufang let Chen Mo stay at An's house so that he could be taken care of.
If it was Chen Mo in his previous life, it would be a dream to be able to live under the same roof with the goddess he secretly loved.
But in this life, Chen Mo, who already knew the face of the An family, really couldn't continue to live in the An family.
What's more, just now, Chen Mo snubbed Miss An. If you go back and settle down now, wouldn't you be asking for trouble?
"We can't go back to the An family, and living in the An family won't be convenient for our future cultivation. It's best to rent a house outside."
Chen Mo made up his mind and planned to go around the school to see if there was a suitable house.
But after touching the few living expenses in his pocket, Chen Mo couldn't help but smile bitterly.
Li Sufang knew Chen Mo's playboy character, so she imposed very strict financial restrictions on Chen Mo. In order to prevent Chen Mo from fooling around outside, she only gave Chen Mo a thousand yuan in pocket money every month.
For an ordinary student, one thousand yuan would be more than enough for food and accommodation, but for Chen Mo in his previous life, it was not enough for him to go to a KTV.
For the first time in his life, Chen Mo, a great monk in the realm of gods, actually worried about money.
However, this little thing couldn't trouble Chen Mo.
He immediately went to the store to buy some cinnabar brushes and white paper, preparing to draw a few simple versions of the talismans. Although the efficacy of these talismans was not one ten thousandth of the original version, for ordinary people on the earth, they were far better than those of Ginseng and Shouwu.
Making several talismans in a secluded place, night has fallen. Chen Mo found a park with a lot of traffic and set up a street stall on the roadside.
At the beginning of the lanterns, a young man in school uniform sat quietly on the side of the road, with several strange ghostly symbols placed on the torn paper in front of him.
The uncles, aunts, and young men and women who passed by looked at Chen Mo and laughed sarcastically. The world is really going downhill these days. Are even students showing off and cheating?
Chen Mo's attitude towards these people was indifferent. Six hundred years of practice had already made his Taoist heart as solid as a rock. These taunts were like a breeze blowing on his face, and he laughed them off.
Chen Mo believes that in the vast sea of ​​​​people, there are always one or two people who know the goods.
"What can you do with these talismans?" A long-haired girl wearing a white down jacket squatted in front of Chen Mo, and gently turned the talisman papers with her green-white hands.
Chen Mo took a look and saw that the girl was about 20 years old. She was tall, with delicate features, fair skin and beautiful appearance. Her temperament was elegant but there was a sense of nobility. She was three points more beautiful than An Keyue!
However, Chen Mo just glanced at it lightly, then withdrew his gaze, pointed at the talisman papers, and said calmly: "Peace the mind and refresh the mind, drive away evil spirits and eliminate darkness, calm the house and calm the wind, and strengthen the body!"
"Ningshen Xingnao?" The girl was stunned, a glimmer of hope flashed through her beautiful eyes, and she stared at Chen Mo and asked: "If someone is insane, often talking nonsense, and even does not recognize the people closest to them, can your talisman cure it?"
Chen Mo pointed at the talisman on the far left and said: "The situation you mentioned, in my opinion, is an imbalance of yin and yang, and the soul of the earth is not returning. Modern medicine explains it as neurasthenia, and the Ningshen Talisman is the most suitable."
The girl picked up the Ning Talisman and examined it carefully. She really couldn't see anything special. Instead, it looked like a child just drew a few random strokes with a pen.
Chen Mo didn't want this guest who was finally interested in these talismans to run away, so he continued to explain: "Human life has three souls and seven souls. Among the three souls, one is the heaven soul, the second is the earth soul, and the third is the life soul. The seven souls are one soul for heaven, the second soul for spiritual wisdom, the third soul for energy, the fourth soul for strength, the fifth soul for breaking the center, the sixth soul for essence, and the seventh soul for heroism."
"Among the three souls, the two souls of heaven and earth are always outside. Only the soul of life lives in the body. The soul of heaven is yang and the soul of earth is yin. If the yang energy is strong, the soul of the sky is strong, and if the yin energy is strong, the soul of the earth is fierce. Only when yin and yang are harmonious can a person be energetic and free from all diseases."
The girl was confused and confused, but she felt that what Chen Mo said seemed to make sense.
